name: Vriska Serket
source:
One of the twelve trolls introduced in Homestuck, the player befriends Vriska in Volume 6 of Pesterquest alongside Gamzee.

Vriska is a haughty and adventurous troll, but her actions cause trouble in her interpersonal relationships.
